turns.text: Hello, come in. How have you been since last time?
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts.
What happened next?
I have not been out of the flat for anything except the clinic in nine days.
Tell me more about that.
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while. It is not easy to talk about.
What happened next?
I wrote a few notes before coming here, but now I cannot remember half of what I wanted to say.
What went through your mind then?
I still check Oliver's breathing at night, last night it was five times.
How did that feel for you?
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little. That is how it was.
Tell me more about that.
The health visitor, Priya, was kind and told me many mothers feel exactly like this.
What happened next?
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television. Yes, it was like that.
Take your time.
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
I stopped breastfeeding last week and I feel like a failure because of it.
How did that feel for you?
The train was late again this morning, so I almost did not make it on time today. Yes, it was like that.
How did that feel for you?
I am not sure where to begin, there are so many things going round in my head at the moment.
Let us stop here for today.
No, I think that is everything. Thank you.
